title: Pullback is silently inert below DEFAULT_ZOOM; the active=false return contract is violated
detail: For any zoom in [1.0, 2.0) the clamp forces z_to >= 2.0 > zoom, so out-of-view districts return active=false — the documented "already inside" contract is false there, and the auto-pullback silently regresses in exactly the manual wheel-out band the directive pushes players into. The old 1.0 floor made this band impossible; no test covers zoom below 2.0.
recommended_fix: Clamp the lower bound to min(DEFAULT_ZOOM, zoom) (falling back to CAM_ZOOM_MIN below the default) so sub-default cameras still get an active ease-out target; or document and pin the sub-default no-op.

title: PR body claims palcheck floors were re-pinned; the diff contains no palcheck change
evidence:

  (e.g. the puck hardware-tone floor) — measured on the re-blessed frames,
  keeping the crop/blit-canary job (a missing sprite still zeroes the count).
detail: The diff touches only the PR body, four source files, tests, and golden PNGs — no palcheck floor values appear anywhere. The claimed re-pin is unbacked by this diff; either the edits are missing or the claim is false.
recommended_fix: Land the re-pinned floor values in the diff (wherever the palcheck floors live) or strike the claim from the PR body.

title: camera_set_fit retained with zero migrated callers — dead code or an un-migrated resting site
evidence:
// v2-camera-zoom-tiers: NO LONGER a resting home — it is the explicit OUT
-	camera_set_fit(app)
+	camera_set_default(app)
  (boot via `start_run`, run reset, the deselect else-branch) now call
detail: The whole diff migrates exactly three call sites (start_run, effect_cancel, camera_set_selection), yet the PR enumerates three resting sites plus ESC. Any unchanged camera_set_fit caller outside these hunks (e.g. a run-reset path) now contradicts the resting-home model; if none exist, the proc is dead.
recommended_fix: Grep for remaining camera_set_fit callers; migrate any resting-state site to camera_set_default, or delete the now-unused proc.

title: New cluster-center test spawns into a bare Topology with no teardown
evidence:
topo: pp.Topology
pp.topology_spawn_node(&topo, ri, {8, 15}, cat)
pp.topology_spawn_node(&topo, rti, {20, 15}, cat)
pp.topology_spawn_node(&topo, hi, {32, 15}, cat)
defer pp.run_destroy(&app6.state)
detail: The test defers only catalogs_destroy while spawning three nodes into a bare Topology; every sibling test defers run_destroy. If topology_spawn_node allocates (as the sibling pattern implies), this leaks per test run.
recommended_fix: Add the topology teardown matching the file's convention (run_destroy equivalent or a topology destroy call).
